title: TAB clef is rejected by the clef-sign enum
description: What every MusicXML tab staff carries — a clef with sign "TAB" — is unrepresentable in MNX v17: the clef-sign enum is C|F|G only. This document is otherwise minimal and valid; the single pinned error is the enum rejection. This is the founding exhibit for the _x.mnxLab.tab extension's design decision that tab-ness is a part-level view declaration, not a clef.
